{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of duplicates: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq
multi_tested = df.groupby('patient_id').size().gt(1).sum()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {multi_tested}")"}
